name: Bird on a Flowering Branch
material: album leaf mounted as a hanging scroll; ink and color on silk
summary: A male redstart sits hunched on the branch of a flowering plum tree in early spring. The bird’s plumage is rendered in fine detail with a great naturalistic sense, characteristic of Southern Song court painting.
